unit:
[Unit]
Description=Ollama HP inference (Ansible managed)
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target homelab-inference-firewall.service
BindsTo=homelab-inference-firewall.service
Requires=homelab-inference-firewall.service

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/ollama serve
User=ollama
Group=ollama
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
Environment="OLLAMA_HOST=192.168.0.118:11434"
Environment="OLLAMA_MODELS=/usr/share/ollama/.ollama/models"
Environment="OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=4096"
Environment="OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1"
Environment="OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1"
Environment="OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD=1"
Environment="OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=30m"

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
